body.name: Generic component-selection exception
body.construction: For \(C\in\mathfrak S_p\), let \(\mathcal E_C\subsetneq\Theta_C\) be the finite union, over \(D\in\mathfrak S_p\) with \(d_D\leq d_C\) and \(\mathcal M(D)\neq\mathcal M(C)\), of the polynomial pullbacks of \(\mathcal M(C)\cap\mathcal M(D)\), augmented by the polynomial zero-gradient loci of the reported nonconstant effect coordinates.
